title: abfzip metadata.json
description: the metadata.json member of an abfzip archive, version 1.x

$schema.description: the schema the object follows (one URI for each major version)

version.description: the version of the specification the file follows, as MAJOR.MINOR

metadata.description: the registry metadata of the recording as a whole

experimenter.description: the person who made the recording, as a username in the registry

animal.description: the animal the recording came from, as its identifier in the registry's animal database

catalog.description: records describing individual members of the archive

value.description: a known value; a key with no known value is left out

record.description: metadata for one member of the archive

path.description: the member's path in the archive, exactly as stored

protocol.description: the acquisition protocol the file was recorded with

start.description: when recording of the file started, as an ISO 8601 date and time (local time if it has no offset)
